args.title: Bellwether Office: Warehouse Automation in 2026 — Summary
args.body:
• Newsletter: Bellwether Office's latest issue spotlights "Warehouse automation in 2026," linking to a blog article plus a companion piece accessible via free email registration.
• Article: In 2026, warehouses using autonomous carts saw pick rates rise 18%, but integration took twice as long as planned.
• Companion piece: The biggest saving from warehouse automation was fewer mis-picks.
